manaNeeded: {1} if Empowered Autogenerator doesn't have a charge counter on it
description:
Animate Empowered Autogenerator using Donatello.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat from step 2.
